sql: SELECT id FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, CASE WHEN sluice_src.email IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(substr(sluice_src.email::varchar, 1, $1), repeat($2, GREATEST((length(sluice_src.email::varchar) - $1) - $3, 0)), substr(sluice_src.email::varchar, GREATEST((length(sluice_src.email::varchar) - $3) + 1, $1 + 1))) END AS email, sluice_src.ssn, sluice_src.salary, sluice_src.notes FROM pg.hr.employees sluice_src) employees WHERE email = 'a@b.c'
